mapper.select: SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.PROJECT_STATUS WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECT' WHEN 'APPROVED_RETURN' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, '暂无工作流，后续sql加上此段逻辑' AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.investment_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, '暂无工作流，后续sql加上此段逻辑' AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE cc.mortgage_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'REVIEW' END AS status, (SELECT ahc.MESSAGE_ FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT ahc WHERE cc.MORTGAGE_INSTANCE_ID=ahc.PROC_INST_ID_ AND ahc.type_ = 'comment' ORDER BY ahc.TIME_ DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS opinion FROM CON_CONTRACT cc INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID WHERE cc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER as orderNo, reqhd.ACTUAL_PAY_DATE as loanTime, reqhd.ACTUAL_HD_PAY_AMOUNT*100 as loanAmount, CASE reqhd.PAYMENT_APPROVED_STATUS WHEN 'PAID' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAIL'END as status, reqhd.payment_type as type FROM prj_project pp LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd reqhd ON reqhd.source_contract_id=cc.contract_id where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AS cashflowId, pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, ccc.TIMES AS termNo, TO_CHAR(ccc.FIN_INCOME_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS trialTime, NVL(ccc.PRINCIPAL, 0)*100 AS principal, NVL(ccc.INTEREST, 0)*100 AS interest, (SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) AS penalty, NVL(ccc.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100+(SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) AS payableAmount FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW ccc INNER JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON ccc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID INNER JOIN hls_penalty_profile_dtl hppd ON hppd.penalty_profile = cc.penalty_profile INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.project_id = pp.project_id WHERE hppd.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND ccc.write_off_flag not in ('FULL') AND ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' AND ccc.times not in (0) AND ccc.cf_item not in (9) AND ccc.due_amount-nvl(ccc.RECEIVED_AMOUNT,0)>0 AND trunc(sysdate) - 30 > trunc(ccc.DUE_DATE) AND trunc(sysdate) - 85 < trunc(ccc.DUE_DATE)
AND ccc.CASHFLOW_ID = #{cashflowId}
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.SIGN_STATUS WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'FINISHED' ELSE 'CREATED' END AS status FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, 'DEDUCT' repayType FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT ccc.TIMES AS termNo, NVL(ccc.PRINCIPAL, 0)*100 AS principal, NVL(ccc.INTEREST, 0)*100 AS interest, (SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) AS penalty, (SELECT NVL(cf1.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf1 WHERE cf1.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND cf1.CF_ITEM=8) AS otherFee, ccc.DUE_AMOUNT*100 + (SELECT NVL(SUM(cf.DUE_AMOUNT), 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf WHERE cf.GENERATED_SOURCE_DOC_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID AND CF_ITEM=9) + (SELECT NVL(cf1.DUE_AMOUNT, 0)*100 FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf1 WHERE cf1.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND cf1.CF_ITEM=8) AS total, ct.TRANSACTION_NO AS transactionNo, ct.EXTERNAL_DEDUCT_NO AS externalDeductNo FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CCC INNER JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc on cc.CONTRACT_ID = ccc.CONTRACT_ID INNER JOIN CSH_TRANSACTION ct on cc.CONTRACT_ID = ct.CONTRACT_ID AND ct.TERM_NO = ccc.times INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID WHERE ct.PAYMENT_METHOD = '代偿' AND ccc.CF_ITEM=1 AND pp.PROJECT_ID=#{projectId}
